'''Rod Latham Jawa Fury''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls9.htm Jawa Fury], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319194202/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls9.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rod Latham]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
